lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Personal Planning Systems Under Real Load
lessonRef.title: Correction and reflection: asking for help before a deadline fails

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic asking for help before a deadline fails task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner thinks of a real or plausible situation from this unit's planning work where they started falling behind, identifies the earliest point they could have noticed it, and drafts the specific sentence or two they would actually say or write to a trusted adult or teacher to ask for help at that early point, without sending it to anyone.
safetyNotes: This draft is never sent or spoken to anyone as part of the lesson; no real adult or teacher needs to be contacted.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Name one specific reason it's hard to ask for help at the early warning sign rather than waiting, and describe one concrete thing you could do to push yourself to ask at that earlier point next time.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Timing and identification of the early warning sign: The identified sign is a genuinely early point in the situation, with a plausible explanation of why it counts as early rather than a last-minute crisis. | Specificity of the help-request statement: The drafted statement names the specific task and either the specific sticking point or the specific help requested. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner draft a second version of the same help-request statement addressed to a different person (a peer or teammate instead of an adult), and explain one specific way the wording changes based on who they're asking.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic asking for help before a deadline fails task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or a document
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: asking for help before a deadline fails coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner thinks of a real or plausible situation from this unit's planning work where they started falling behind, identifies the earliest point they could have noticed it, and drafts the specific sentence or two they would actually say or write to a trusted adult or teacher to ask for help at that early point, without sending it to anyone.
Coach direction: Think of a real or plausible situation where a plan started slipping before the deadline arrived.
Learner prompt: Describe the situation: what was the task, and what was the earliest specific sign that it was starting to fall behind schedule (not the moment it became a full crisis)?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: asking for help before a deadline fails complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Compare asking for help early to asking after the deadline has already failed.

Response 1 (t2-p1): Explain one specific thing a trusted adult or teacher could actually do to help if asked at the early warning sign, that they could no longer do once the deadline has already passed.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I identified a specific person (a role, such as 'my history teacher' or 'a trusted adult in my household,' not a name) I would ask for help in this situation.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: asking for help before a deadline fails minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.

Reflection: Name one specific reason it's hard to ask for help at the early warning sign rather than waiting, and describe one concrete thing you could do to push yourself to ask at that earlier point next time.

Success checks: Timing and identification of the early warning sign: The identified sign is a genuinely early point in the situation, with a plausible explanation of why it counts as early rather than a last-minute crisis. | Specificity of the help-request statement: The drafted statement names the specific task and either the specific sticking point or the specific help requested.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: asking for help before a deadline fails supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional asking for help before a deadline fails condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Timing and identification of the early warning sign: The identified sign is a genuinely early point in the situation, with a plausible explanation of why it counts as early rather than a last-minute crisis. | Specificity of the help-request statement: The drafted statement names the specific task and either the specific sticking point or the specific help requested..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g9-u01-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
